translation: (Directly above the pupil, entering the hairline five fen, in the depression.) Descending on the forehead, it joins hand-foot Shaoyang and Yangming, five vessels, at Yangbai (GB14). (One cun above the eyebrow, directly facing the pupil.) Following the head it enters the ear, and ascending reaches Benshen (GB13) and stops. (Benshen is directly above the ear in the hairline.) In all there are thirty-two points.
